ov: A North American wild dog, smaller than its close relative the grey wolf. It adapts well to places people have changed, and urban coyotes are now common in many cities. In 2013 one was seen across the Panama Canal for the first time.

why.dg: Attacks on people are uncommon and rarely serious, though coyotes have targeted small children.
why.ac: Essentially nocturnal, though sometimes seen in daylight.

rg: North America, south into Central America as far as Panama.

cf.tip: A coyote is smaller than a grey wolf, its close relative.
The coyote fills much the same niche in North America as the golden jackal does in Eurasia, but is generally larger.

fx: It is also called the American jackal, prairie wolf and brush wolf.
